```{r load shapefiles}

mongoliaoutline <- st_read("mng_admbnda_adm0_nso_20201019.shp")

# Remove rows with missing coordinates
    rodents1 <- rodents1[!is.na(rodents1$Longitude) & !is.na(rodents1$Latitude), ]
    rodents2 <- rodents2[!is.na(rodents2$Longitude) & !is.na(rodents2$Latitude), ]
  
# Convert coordinates to sf object
    points1 <- st_as_sf(rodents1, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
    points2 <- st_as_sf(rodents2, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
    
# Plot points on shapefile
    ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = mongoliaoutline, fill = "gray90", color = "black") +
      geom_sf(data = points2, color = "purple", size = 2) +
      geom_sf(data = points1, color = "red", size = 2) +
      theme_minimal()
    
# remove rodents1 points outside of Mongolia boundary
    # Keep points inside or on the Mongolia boundary
      inside1 <- st_intersects(
        points1, mongoliaoutline, sparse = FALSE
      )[, 1]

    # Filter rodents1 and points1
      rodents1 <- rodents1[inside1, ]
      points1 <- points1[inside1, ]
      
# Plot filter points on shapefile
    ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = mongoliaoutline, fill = "gray90", color = "black") +
      geom_sf(data = points3, color = "green", size = 2) +
      geom_sf(data = points1, color = "blue", size = 2) +
      theme_minimal()

```

```{r combine datasets}

# extract genus and standardize species names
    points1$Genus <- sub(" .*", "", points1$`Rodent species`)
    points2$Genus <- sub(" .*", "", points2$Species)
    
    points1$Species <- points1$`Rodent species`
    points1$Dataset <- "Rodents 1"
    
    points2$Dataset <- "Rodents 2"

# combine datasets
    rodents_combined <- bind_rows(points1, points2)

# Count unique coordinates per species
    species_counts <- rodents_combined %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      distinct(Species, Longitude, Latitude) %>%
      count(Species, name = "unique_coordinates") %>%
      arrange(desc(unique_coordinates))
    
    print(species_counts, n = Inf)

# Keep species with more than 20 unique coordinates
    species_over20 <- species_counts %>%
      filter(unique_coordinates > 20)

# Filter the combined spatial dataset
    rodents_over20 <- rodents_combined %>%
      semi_join(species_over20, by = "Species")

```

```{r load environmental data}
#make type 3 modis a single land cover layer (2018-2022) representing the majority class over years
#load saved rasterbrick file
  modis_type3 <- brick("modis_type3.tif")

#define a function to calculate the modal value ignoring NAs
  modal <- function(x) {
    ux <- unique(na.omit(x))
    if(length(ux) == 0) return(NA)
    ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x,ux)))]
  }
  
#apply modal function pixel-wise (each pixel assigned the most common land-cover value)
  modis3_modal <- calc(modis_type3, fun=modal)
  
#convert to factor
  modis3_modal <- as.factor(modis3_modal)

#save modis3_modal rasterbrick
  writeRaster(modis3_modal, filename="modis3_modal.tif", format="GTiff", overwrite= TRUE)
  
plot(modis3_modal)
```

```{r Combining environmental data}

# check rasters CRS
    crs(bioclimcroppedrast)
    crs(elevclipped_rast)
    crs(soilhumclipped_rast)
    crs(soilclayclipped_rast)
    crs(soilsandclipped_rast)
    crs(soilsiltclipped_rast)
    crs(modis3_modal)
    
#crop modis to Mongolia
    modis3 <- crop(modis3_modal, extent(bioclimcroppedrast))
    
#check extent
    extent(bioclimcroppedrast)
    extent(elevclipped_rast)
    extent(soilhumclipped_rast)
    extent(soilclayclipped_rast)
    extent(soilsandclipped_rast)
    extent(soilsiltclipped_rast)
    extent(modis3)

# convert to as.factor
    modis_resampled <-  resample(modis3, bioclimcroppedrast, method="ngb")
    modis3_raster <- as.factor(modis_resampled)

#resample soil raster to Bioclim (continuous)
    soilhum_resampled <-  resample(soilhumclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method="bilinear")
    soilclay_resampled <-  resample (soilclayclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")
    soilsand_resampled <-  resample (soilsandclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")
    soilsilt_resampled <-  resample (soilsiltclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")
    elev_resampled <-  resample (elevclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")
    soilbd_resampled <-  resample (soilbdclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")
    soilcd_resampled <-  resample (soilcdclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")
    soilnit_resampled <-  resample (soilnitclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")
    soilph_resampled <-  resample (soilphclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")
    soilcoarse_resampled <-  resample (soilcoarseclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")
    soilcarbon_resampled <-  resample (soilcarbonclipped_rast, bioclimcroppedrast, method= "bilinear")

# combine environmental data rasters
    environmental_combined <- stack(
        bioclimcroppedrast,

        soilhum_resampled,
        soilclay_resampled,
        soilsand_resampled,

        soilnit_resampled,

# check CRS for raster
    crs(environmental_combined)
    
# reset MODIS as factor
    environmental_combined[[2]] <- as.factor(environmental_combined[[2]])
    
# save env raster
  save(environmental_combined, file = "environmental_combined.RData")
```

```{r VIF}

# define variables to exclude
    drop_vars <- c(
      "AnnMeanTemp",
      "TempAnnRnge",
      "TempSeasonality",
      "PrcpDryQrt",
      "MeanDiurnRange",
      "MaxTempWarmMnth",
      "MTempWarmQurt",
      "MTempCldQurt",
      "Isothermality",
      "PrcpWetQurt",
      "PrcpDryQurt",
      "PrcpWetMnth",
      "AnnPrcp",
      "soilgrid2_mongolia",
      "pHwater_soilgrids",
      "sand_soilgrids",
      "nitrogen_soilgrids",
      "bulkdensity_soilgrids",
      "silt_soilgrids",
      "carbondensity_soilgrids",
      "layer"
    )

# split occurrence data by species
    species_list <- split(rodents_over20, rodents_over20$'Rodent species')

# Store VIF results and diagnostic information
    vif_results <- list()
    vif_summary <- data.frame()
    
    for (sp in names(species_list)) {

      cat("\nProcessing species:", sp, "\n")
    
      # Get records for this species and retain unique coordinates
      sp_data <- species_list[[sp]]
      coords <- st_coordinates(sp_data)
    
      unique_idx <- !duplicated(
        data.frame(Longitude = coords[, 1], Latitude = coords[, 2])
      )
    
      sp_data <- sp_data[unique_idx, ]
      coords <- st_coordinates(sp_data)
    
      # Extract environmental variables at occurrence locations
      env <- raster::extract(environmental_combined, coords)
    
      env <- as.data.frame(env)
    
      # Remove rows with missing environmental values
      env <- env[complete.cases(env), , drop = FALSE]
    
      # Remove selected environmental variables
      env <- env[, !names(env) %in% drop_vars, drop = FALSE]
    
      # Remove non-variable predictors
      variable_cols <- vapply(env, function(x) {
        length(unique(x)) > 1
      }, logical(1))
    
      env <- env[, variable_cols, drop = FALSE]
    
      # Check whether enough records remain
      if (nrow(env) < 2 || ncol(env) < 2) {
        cat("Skipped: insufficient complete records or predictors\n")
        next
      }
    
      # Run VIF, capturing errors for problematic species
      result <- tryCatch(
        usdm::vif(env),
        error = function(e) {
          cat("VIF failed for", sp, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
          NULL
        }
      )
    
      if (!is.null(result)) {
        vif_results[[sp]] <- result
    
        vif_summary <- rbind(
          vif_summary,
          data.frame(
            Species = sp,
            Unique_locations = nrow(sp_data),
            Complete_records = nrow(env),
            Predictors = ncol(env)
          )
        )
    
        cat("VIF completed for:", sp, "\n")
        print(result)
      }
    }

# Review species processed successfully
    print(vif_summary)

# Inspect VIF results for a particular species
    names(vif_results)

```

```{r Pseudoabsences}

# environmental predictors retained after VIF
    rodent_vars <- c(
      "MinTempColdMnth",
      "PrcpDryMnth",
      "PrcpSeasonality",
      "clay_soilgrids",
      "wc2.1_30s_elev",
      "coarsefrag_soilgrids",
      "organiccarbon_soilgrids"
    )

    missing_vars <- setdiff(
      rodent_vars,
      names(environmental_combined)
    )

    if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Missing environmental layers: ",
        paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    environmental_rodents <- environmental_combined[[rodent_vars]]

# define species and replicate settings
    set.seed(100)
    nrep <- 50
    
    species_list <- split(rodents_over20, rodents_over20$Species)
    
    rodent_train_list <- list()
    rodent_test_list <- list()
    
    # Use first raster layer to identify raster cells
    reference_raster <- environmental_rodents[[1]]

# process each species
    for (sp_name in names(species_list)) {
    
      # Unique presence coordinates
      sp_data <- species_list[[sp_name]] %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(Longitude),
          !is.na(Latitude)
        ) %>%
        distinct(Longitude, Latitude)
    
      if (nrow(sp_data) < 10) {
        warning("Skipping ", sp_name, ": fewer than 10 locations.")
        next
      }
    
      presence_sf <- st_as_sf(
        sp_data,
        coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
        crs = 4326
      )
    
      # Keep presence points within/on Mongolia
      inside <- st_intersects(
        presence_sf,
        mongolia_outline_sp,
        sparse = FALSE
      )[, 1]
    
      presence_sf <- presence_sf[inside, ]
    
      if (nrow(presence_sf) < 10) {
        warning("Skipping ", sp_name, ": too few points in Mongolia.")
        next
      }
    
      # Raster cell IDs for presence locations
      presence_xy <- st_coordinates(presence_sf)
    
      presence_cells <- raster::cellFromXY(
        reference_raster,
        presence_xy
      )
    
      presence_cells <- unique(
        presence_cells[!is.na(presence_cells)]
      )
    
      # Remove presences falling outside raster coverage
      valid_presence <- !is.na(
        raster::extract(reference_raster, presence_xy)
      )
    
      presence_sf <- presence_sf[valid_presence, ]
    
      if (nrow(presence_sf) < 10) {
        warning("Skipping ", sp_name, ": insufficient raster coverage.")
        next
      }
    
      presence_sf$presence <- 1
    
      # Recalculate cells after filtering
      presence_cells <- unique(
        raster::cellFromXY(
          reference_raster,
          st_coordinates(presence_sf)
        )
      )
    
      n_presence <- nrow(presence_sf)
    
      rodent_train_list[[sp_name]] <- vector("list", nrep)
      rodent_test_list[[sp_name]] <- vector("list", nrep)
    
      # generate pseudoabsences for each replicate
      for (r in seq_len(nrep)) {
    
        # Accumulate valid background points
        pseudo_candidates <- list()
        n_found <- 0
        attempts <- 0
        max_attempts <- 100
    
        while (n_found < n_presence &&
               attempts < max_attempts) {
    
          attempts <- attempts + 1
    
          # Oversample candidate locations within Mongolia
          candidate_geom <- st_sample(
            mongolia_boundary,
            size = max(100, 3 * (n_presence - n_found)),
            type = "random"
          )
    
          candidate_sf <- st_sf(geometry = candidate_geom)
    
          # Extract predictor values
          candidate_env <- raster::extract(
            environmental_rodents,
            as(candidate_sf, "Spatial")
          )
    
          candidate_env <- as.data.frame(candidate_env)
    
          # Remove candidates with missing predictors
          complete <- complete.cases(candidate_env)
    
          candidate_sf <- candidate_sf[complete, ]
          candidate_env <- candidate_env[complete, , drop = FALSE]
    
          if (nrow(candidate_sf) == 0) next
    
          # Exclude raster cells containing presences
          candidate_cells <- raster::cellFromXY(
            reference_raster,
            st_coordinates(candidate_sf)
          )
    
          keep <- !is.na(candidate_cells) &
            !(candidate_cells %in% presence_cells)
    
          candidate_sf <- candidate_sf[keep, ]
          candidate_cells <- candidate_cells[keep]
    
          if (nrow(candidate_sf) == 0) next
    
          # Avoid duplicate pseudoabsence raster cells
          previously_sampled <- if (length(pseudo_candidates) > 0) {
            unlist(lapply(
              pseudo_candidates,
              function(x) x$cells
            ))
          } else {
            integer(0)
          }
    
          keep <- !(candidate_cells %in% previously_sampled)
    
          candidate_sf <- candidate_sf[keep, ]
          candidate_cells <- candidate_cells[keep]
    
          if (nrow(candidate_sf) == 0) next
    
          # Retain only the number still needed
          n_needed <- n_presence - n_found
          take <- min(n_needed, nrow(candidate_sf))
    
          candidate_sf <- candidate_sf[seq_len(take), ]
          candidate_cells <- candidate_cells[seq_len(take)]
    
          pseudo_candidates[[length(pseudo_candidates) + 1]] <-
            list(points = candidate_sf, cells = candidate_cells)
    
          n_found <- n_found + take
        }
    
        if (n_found < n_presence) {
          warning(
            "Insufficient valid pseudoabsences for ",
            sp_name, ", replicate ", r,
            ". Skipping this replicate."
          )
          next
        }
    
        pseudo_sf <- do.call(
          rbind,
          lapply(pseudo_candidates, function(x) x$points)
        )
    
        pseudo_sf$presence <- 0
    
        # Combine presences and pseudoabsences
        all_points <- rbind(
          presence_sf[, "presence"],
          pseudo_sf[, "presence"]
        )
    
        # split 75% training and 25% testing
        train_index <- caret::createDataPartition(
          all_points$presence,
          p = 0.75,
          list = FALSE
        )
    
        train_sf <- all_points[train_index, ]
        test_sf <- all_points[-train_index, ]
    
        # extract environmental predictors
        train_env <- as.data.frame(
          raster::extract(
            environmental_rodents,
            as(train_sf, "Spatial")
          )
        )
    
        test_env <- as.data.frame(
          raster::extract(
            environmental_rodents,
            as(test_sf, "Spatial")
          )
        )
    
        train_df <- data.frame(
          presence = train_sf$presence,
          train_env
        )
    
        test_df <- data.frame(
          presence = test_sf$presence,
          test_env
        )
    
        train_df <- na.omit(train_df)
        test_df <- na.omit(test_df)
    
        # Store replicate datasets
        rodent_train_list[[sp_name]][[r]] <- train_df
        rodent_test_list[[sp_name]][[r]] <- test_df
      }
    
      # Save after each species
      saveRDS(
        rodent_train_list,
        "rodent_train_list.rds"
      )
    
      saveRDS(
        rodent_test_list,
        "rodent_test_list.rds"
      )
    }

# check results
    print(names(rodent_train_list))
    
    first_species <- names(rodent_train_list)[1]
    
    print(dim(rodent_train_list[[first_species]][[1]]))
    print(dim(rodent_test_list[[first_species]][[1]]))
    
    print(names(rodent_train_list[[first_species]][[1]]))
    
    table(rodent_train_list[[first_species]][[1]]$presence)
    table(rodent_test_list[[first_species]][[1]]$presence)
```

```{r BRT 50 replicates}

# load training and testing datasets
    rodent_train_list <- readRDS("rodent_train_list.rds")
    rodent_test_list  <- readRDS("rodent_test_list.rds")

# output directory
    output_folder <- "Rodent_BRT_Results"
    
    dir.create(output_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    dir.create(file.path(output_folder, "Models"),
               showWarnings = FALSE)
    dir.create(file.path(output_folder, "Maps"),
               showWarnings = FALSE)
    dir.create(file.path(output_folder, "Variable_Importance"),
               showWarnings = FALSE)

# number of replicates
    nrep <- 50

# functions for model evaluation
    calculate_metrics <- function(observed, predicted) {
    
      # Remove missing predictions
      keep <- complete.cases(observed, predicted)
      observed <- observed[keep]
      predicted <- predicted[keep]
    
      if (length(unique(observed)) < 2) {
        return(data.frame(
          AUC = NA_real_,
          Threshold = NA_real_,
          Sensitivity = NA_real_,
          Specificity = NA_real_,
          TSS = NA_real_
        ))
      }
    
      # AUC
      auc_value <- tryCatch({
        as.numeric(
          pROC::auc(
            pROC::roc(
              observed,
              predicted,
              levels = c(0, 1),
              direction = "<",
              quiet = TRUE
            )
          )
        )
      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    
      # Find the threshold maximizing TSS
      thresholds <- sort(unique(predicted))
    
      if (length(thresholds) > 500) {
        thresholds <- unique(as.numeric(
          quantile(predicted, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 500),
                   na.rm = TRUE)
        ))
      }
    
      results <- lapply(thresholds, function(threshold) {
    
        predicted_class <- ifelse(predicted >= threshold, 1, 0)
    
        TP <- sum(observed == 1 & predicted_class == 1)
        FN <- sum(observed == 1 & predicted_class == 0)
        TN <- sum(observed == 0 & predicted_class == 0)
        FP <- sum(observed == 0 & predicted_class == 1)
    
        sensitivity <- if ((TP + FN) > 0) {
          TP / (TP + FN)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
    
        specificity <- if ((TN + FP) > 0) {
          TN / (TN + FP)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
    
        data.frame(
          Threshold = threshold,
          Sensitivity = sensitivity,
          Specificity = specificity,
          TSS = sensitivity + specificity - 1
        )
      })
    
      results <- do.call(rbind, results)
      results <- results[is.finite(results$TSS), ]
    
      if (nrow(results) == 0) {
        return(data.frame(
          AUC = auc_value,
          Threshold = NA_real_,
          Sensitivity = NA_real_,
          Specificity = NA_real_,
          TSS = NA_real_
        ))
      }
    
      best <- results[which.max(results$TSS), ]
    
      data.frame(
        AUC = auc_value,
        Threshold = best$Threshold,
        Sensitivity = best$Sensitivity,
        Specificity = best$Specificity,
        TSS = best$TSS
      )
    }

# store results
    evaluation_results <- list()
    importance_results <- list()
    boyce_results <- list()

# fit BRTs for each rodent species
    species_list <- intersect(
      names(rodent_train_list),
      names(rodent_test_list)
    )
    
    for (sp_name in species_list) {
    
      message("\n========================================")
      message("Species: ", sp_name)
      message("========================================")
    
      train_reps <- rodent_train_list[[sp_name]]
      test_reps  <- rodent_test_list[[sp_name]]
    
      if (length(train_reps) == 0 || length(test_reps) == 0) {
        warning("No training/testing replicates for ", sp_name)
        next
      }
    
      species_eval <- list()
      species_importance <- list()
      species_boyce <- list()
      species_predictions <- list()
    
      for (r in seq_len(min(nrep, length(train_reps),
                            length(test_reps)))) {
    
        message("  Replicate ", r, " of ", nrep)
    
        train_df <- as.data.frame(train_reps[[r]])
        test_df  <- as.data.frame(test_reps[[r]])
    
        if (is.null(train_df) || is.null(test_df) ||
            nrow(train_df) == 0 || nrow(test_df) == 0) {
          next
        }
    
        # Check required variables
        required_vars <- c("presence", rodent_vars)
    
        if (!all(required_vars %in% names(train_df)) ||
            !all(required_vars %in% names(test_df))) {
          warning("Required columns missing for ", sp_name,
                  ", replicate ", r)
          next
        }
    
        train_df <- train_df[, required_vars, drop = FALSE]
        test_df  <- test_df[, required_vars, drop = FALSE]
    
        train_df <- na.omit(train_df)
        test_df  <- na.omit(test_df)
    
        train_df$presence <- as.numeric(train_df$presence)
        test_df$presence  <- as.numeric(test_df$presence)
    
        # Both classes must be present
        if (length(unique(train_df$presence)) < 2 ||
            length(unique(test_df$presence)) < 2) {
          warning("Only one class in data for ", sp_name,
                  ", replicate ", r)
          next
        }
    
        # Ensure predictors are numeric
        train_df[rodent_vars] <- lapply(
          train_df[rodent_vars], as.numeric
        )
        test_df[rodent_vars] <- lapply(
          test_df[rodent_vars], as.numeric
        )
    
        # fit BRT
        brt_model <- tryCatch({
    
          dismo::gbm.step(
            data = train_df,
            gbm.x = match(rodent_vars, names(train_df)),
            gbm.y = match("presence", names(train_df)),
            family = "bernoulli",
            tree.complexity = 2,
            learning.rate = 0.001,
            bag.fraction = 0.75,
            cv.folds = 5,
            max.trees = 10000,
            n.trees = 50,
            step.size = 50,
            verbose = FALSE
          )
    
        }, error = function(e) {
          warning("BRT failed for ", sp_name,
                  ", replicate ", r, ": ", e$message)
          NULL
        })
    
        if (is.null(brt_model)) next
    
        # Save model
        safe_species <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", sp_name)
    
        saveRDS(
          brt_model,
          file.path(
            output_folder, "Models",
            paste0(safe_species, "_rep", r, ".rds")
          )
        )
        
        # predict on test data
        test_pred <- tryCatch({
    
          predict(
            brt_model,
            newdata = test_df[, rodent_vars, drop = FALSE],
            n.trees = brt_model$gbm.call$best.trees,
            type = "response"
          )
    
        }, error = function(e) {
          warning("Test prediction failed for ", sp_name,
                  ", replicate ", r, ": ", e$message)
          NULL
        })
    
        if (is.null(test_pred)) next
    
        # Evaluate held-out data
        metrics <- calculate_metrics(
          observed = test_df$presence,
          predicted = test_pred
        )
    
        metrics$Species <- sp_name
        metrics$Replicate <- r
    
        species_eval[[r]] <- metrics
    
        # variable importance
        importance <- tryCatch({
    
          summary(
            brt_model,
            n.trees = brt_model$gbm.call$best.trees,
            plotit = FALSE
          )
    
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
        if (!is.null(importance)) {
    
          importance <- as.data.frame(importance)
          importance$Species <- sp_name
          importance$Replicate <- r
    
          species_importance[[r]] <- importance
        }
    
        # predict habitat suitability across Mongolia
        suitability <- tryCatch({
    
          raster::predict(
            environmental_rodents,
            brt_model,
            n.trees = brt_model$gbm.call$best.trees,
            type = "response",
            na.rm = TRUE,
            progress = "text"
          )
    
        }, error = function(e) {
          warning("Raster prediction failed for ", sp_name,
                  ", replicate ", r, ": ", e$message)
          NULL
        })
    
        if (!is.null(suitability)) {
    
          species_predictions[[length(species_predictions) + 1]] <-
            suitability
    
          writeRaster(
            suitability,
            filename = file.path(
              output_folder, "Maps",
              paste0(safe_species, "_rep", r, ".tif")
            ),
            format = "GTiff",
            overwrite = TRUE
          )
    
          # Continuous Boyce Index
          if (requireNamespace("ecospat", quietly = TRUE)) {
    
            presence_test <- test_df$presence == 1
    
            boyce <- tryCatch({
    
              ecospat::ecospat.boyce(
                fit = raster::getValues(suitability),
                obs = test_pred[presence_test],
                nclass = 0,
                PEplot = FALSE
              )$Spearman.cor
    
            }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    
            species_boyce[[r]] <- data.frame(
              Species = sp_name,
              Replicate = r,
              Boyce = as.numeric(boyce)
            )
          }
        }
    
        # Save progress after each replicate
        if (length(species_eval) > 0) {
          evaluation_results[[sp_name]] <-
            do.call(rbind, species_eval)
        }
    
        if (length(species_importance) > 0) {
          importance_results[[sp_name]] <-
            do.call(rbind, species_importance)
        }
    
        if (length(species_boyce) > 0) {
          boyce_results[[sp_name]] <-
            do.call(rbind, species_boyce)
        }
    
        saveRDS(
          evaluation_results,
          file.path(output_folder, "evaluation_results_progress.rds")
        )
      }
    
      # summarize predictions for each species
      if (length(species_predictions) > 0) {
    
        prediction_stack <- raster::stack(species_predictions)
    
        mean_suitability <- raster::calc(
          prediction_stack, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE
        )
    
        sd_suitability <- raster::calc(
          prediction_stack, fun = sd, na.rm = TRUE
        )
    
        safe_species <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", sp_name)
    
        writeRaster(
          mean_suitability,
          filename = file.path(
            output_folder, "Maps",
            paste0(safe_species, "_mean_suitability.tif")
          ),
          format = "GTiff",
          overwrite = TRUE
        )
    
        writeRaster(
          sd_suitability,
          filename = file.path(
            output_folder, "Maps",
            paste0(safe_species, "_sd_suitability.tif")
          ),
          format = "GTiff",
          overwrite = TRUE
        )
      }
    
      # Save species results
      saveRDS(
        evaluation_results,
        file.path(output_folder, "evaluation_results.rds")
      )
    
      saveRDS(
        importance_results,
        file.path(output_folder, "variable_importance.rds")
      )
    
      saveRDS(
        boyce_results,
        file.path(output_folder, "boyce_results.rds")
      )
    }

# export summary tables
    if (length(evaluation_results) > 0) {
      evaluation_df <- do.call(rbind, evaluation_results)
      write.csv(
        evaluation_df,
        file.path(output_folder, "BRT_evaluation_results.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
    
      # Summarize mean and SD of metrics across replicates
      metric_names <- c(
        "AUC", "Threshold", "Sensitivity",
        "Specificity", "TSS"
      )
    
      evaluation_summary <- evaluation_df %>%
        group_by(Species) %>%
        summarise(
          across(
            all_of(metric_names),
            list(
              mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
            ),
            .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
          ),
          n_replicates = n(),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    
      write.csv(
        evaluation_summary,
        file.path(output_folder, "BRT_evaluation_summary.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    if (length(importance_results) > 0) {
    
      importance_df <- do.call(rbind, importance_results)
    
      write.csv(
        importance_df,
        file.path(output_folder, "BRT_variable_importance.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    if (length(boyce_results) > 0) {
    
      boyce_df <- do.call(rbind, boyce_results)
    
      write.csv(
        boyce_df,
        file.path(output_folder, "BRT_boyce_results.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
    }
```

```{r outputting rodent BRT plots}

# define input and output folders
# Folder containing mean and SD rasters from the rodent BRT analysis
    input_folder <- file.path("Rodent_BRT_Results", "Maps")

# Output folder for plots
    output_folder <- file.path("Mongolia_rodentdata","BRT_Plots")

    dir.create(
      output_folder,
      recursive = TRUE,
      showWarnings = FALSE
    )

# define plotting settings
    plasma_colors <- viridis::plasma(100)
    
# Mongolia projection
    mongolia_crs <- paste0(
      "+proj=lcc ",
      "+lat_1=44 ",
      "+lat_2=50 ",
      "+lat_0=46 ",
      "+lon_0=103 ",
      "+datum=WGS84 ",
      "+units=m ",
      "+no_defs"
    )

# plotting function
    plot_brt_map <- function(
        prediction_raster,
        filename,
        map_title,
        output_folder,
        mongolia_crs,
        plasma_colors,
        legend_title = "Habitat\nsuitability",
        limits = c(0, 1)
    ) {
    
      # Project raster for plotting
      plot_raster <- terra::project(
        prediction_raster,
        mongolia_crs,
        method = "bilinear"
      )
    
      # Convert raster to dataframe
      map_df <- terra::as.data.frame(
        plot_raster,
        xy = TRUE,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    
      names(map_df)[3] <- "suitability"
    
      # Create map
      brt_map <- ggplot(
        map_df,
        aes(
          x = x,
          y = y,
          fill = suitability
        )
      ) +
        geom_raster() +
        scale_fill_gradientn(
          colours = plasma_colors,
          limits = limits,
          breaks = seq(
            limits[1],
            limits[2],
            length.out = 5
          ),
          oob = scales::squish,
          name = legend_title
        ) +
        coord_sf(
          crs = sf::st_crs(mongolia_crs),
          expand = FALSE
        ) +
        ggspatial::annotation_scale(
          location = "br",
          width_hint = 0.30,
          unit_category = "metric",
          unit = "km",
          breaks = 500,
          text_cex = 1,
          style = "ticks"
        ) +
        ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(
          location = "tl",
          which_north = "true",
          style = ggspatial::north_arrow_minimal,
          height = unit(0.6, "cm"),
          width = unit(0.6, "cm"),
          pad_x = unit(0.2, "cm"),
          pad_y = unit(0.2, "cm")
        ) +
        labs(
          title = map_title,
          x = NULL,
          y = NULL
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(
            size = 16,
            hjust = 0.5
          ),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
        )
    
      # Export SVG
      ggsave(
        filename = file.path(
          output_folder,
          paste0(filename, ".svg")
        ),
        plot = brt_map,
        width = 8,
        height = 6,
        units = "in",
        dpi = 300
      )
    
      # Export PNG
      ggsave(
        filename = file.path(
          output_folder,
          paste0(filename, ".png")
        ),
        plot = brt_map,
        width = 8,
        height = 6,
        units = "in",
        dpi = 300
      )
    
      return(brt_map)
    }

# export mean habitat suitability maps
    mean_files <- list.files(
      input_folder,
      pattern = "_mean_suitability\\.tif$",
      full.names = TRUE
    )
    
    if (length(mean_files) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No mean suitability rasters found in: ",
        input_folder
      )
    }
    
    mean_maps <- list()
    
    for (raster_file in mean_files) {
    
      species_name <- sub(
        "_mean_suitability\\.tif$",
        "",
        basename(raster_file)
      )
    
      message("Plotting mean suitability: ", species_name)
    
      mean_prediction <- terra::rast(raster_file)
    
      mean_maps[[species_name]] <- plot_brt_map(
        prediction_raster = mean_prediction,
        filename = paste0(species_name, "_Mean_BRT_Map"),
        map_title = paste(
          gsub("_", " ", species_name),
          "Mean Habitat Suitability"
        ),
        output_folder = output_folder,
        mongolia_crs = mongolia_crs,
        plasma_colors = plasma_colors,
        legend_title = "Mean habitat\nsuitability",
        limits = c(0, 1)
      )
    
      print(mean_maps[[species_name]])
    }

# export standard deviation maps
    sd_files <- list.files(
      input_folder,
      pattern = "_sd_suitability\\.tif$",
      full.names = TRUE
    )
    
    sd_maps <- list()
    
    for (raster_file in sd_files) {
    
      species_name <- sub(
        "_sd_suitability\\.tif$",
        "",
        basename(raster_file)
      )
    
      message("Plotting prediction variability: ", species_name)
    
      sd_prediction <- terra::rast(raster_file)
    
      sd_maps[[species_name]] <- plot_brt_map(
        prediction_raster = sd_prediction,
        filename = paste0(species_name, "_SD_BRT_Map"),
        map_title = paste(
          gsub("_", " ", species_name),
          "Prediction Variability"
        ),
        output_folder = output_folder,
        mongolia_crs = mongolia_crs,
        plasma_colors = plasma_colors,
        legend_title = "Prediction SD",
        limits = c(0, 0.5)
      )
    
      print(sd_maps[[species_name]])
    }
```

```{r BRT relative influence Rodents}

# set output folder
    output_folder <- "Rodent_BRT_Results"
    
    importance_folder <- file.path(output_folder, "Variable_Importance")
    
    dir.create(
      importance_folder,
      recursive = TRUE,
      showWarnings = FALSE
    )

# load variable importance results
    importance_results <- readRDS(
      file.path(
        output_folder,
        "variable_importance.rds"
      )
    )

# define predictor names and labels
    rodent_var_labels <- c(
      "MinTempColdMnth" = "Minimum Temperature of Coldest Month",
      "PrcpDryMnth" = "Precipitation of Driest Month",
      "PrcpSeasonality" = "Precipitation Seasonality",
      "clay_soilgrids" = "Soil Clay Content",
      "wc2.1_30s_elev" = "Elevation",
      "coarsefrag_soilgrids" = "Soil Coarse Fragments",
      "organiccarbon_soilgrids" = "Soil Organic Carbon"
    )

# function to plot variable relative influence
    plot_variable_importance <- function(
        importance_df,
        species_name,
        filename,
        output_folder,
        rodent_var_labels
    ) {
    
      # confirm the data has the required columns
      required_columns <- c("var", "rel.inf")
    
      if (!all(required_columns %in% names(importance_df))) {
        warning(
          "Missing required columns for ", species_name,
          ". Available columns: ",
          paste(names(importance_df), collapse = ", ")
        )
        return(NULL)
      }
    
      # Calculate mean relative influence across replicates
      rel_inf <- importance_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          !is.na(var),
          !is.na(rel.inf)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(var) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          Mean_Relative_Influence = mean(rel.inf, na.rm = TRUE),
          SD_Relative_Influence = sd(rel.inf, na.rm = TRUE),
          N = dplyr::n(),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          var = as.character(var),
          var_label = dplyr::if_else(
            var %in% names(rodent_var_labels),
            unname(rodent_var_labels[var]),
            var
          )
        ) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(Mean_Relative_Influence)
    
      if (nrow(rel_inf) == 0) {
        warning("No usable variable importance data for ", species_name)
        return(NULL)
      }
    
      # Order bars from lowest to highest
      rel_inf$var_label <- factor(
        rel_inf$var_label,
        levels = rel_inf$var_label
      )
    
      # Create plot
      importance_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
        rel_inf,
        ggplot2::aes(
          x = var_label,
          y = Mean_Relative_Influence,
          fill = Mean_Relative_Influence
        )
      ) +
        ggplot2::geom_col() +
        ggplot2::coord_flip() +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
          colours = viridis::plasma(100)[1:50]
        ) +
        ggplot2::geom_text(
          ggplot2::aes(
            label = round(Mean_Relative_Influence, 2)
          ),
          hjust = -0.1,
          size = 4
        ) +
        ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
          expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))
        ) +
        ggplot2::labs(
          title = paste(
            "Variable Relative Influence:",
            species_name
          ),
          x = NULL,
          y = "Mean Relative Influence (%)",
          fill = "Relative Influence"
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
        ggplot2::theme(
          axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
          axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
          plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
            size = 13,
            face = "bold"
          ),
          panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
        )
    
      # Save plot
      output_file <- file.path(
        output_folder,
        paste0(filename, ".svg")
      )
    
      ggplot2::ggsave(
        filename = output_file,
        plot = importance_plot,
        width = 10,
        height = 6,
        units = "in"
      )
    
      message("Saved: ", output_file)
    
      return(importance_plot)
    }

# loop through all rodent species
    rodent_importance_plots <- list()
    
    for (sp_name in names(importance_results)) {
      message("\nProcessing species: ", sp_name)
      species_importance <- importance_results[[sp_name]]
    
      # Check the data structure
      if (is.null(species_importance)) {
        warning("NULL importance data for: ", sp_name)
        next
      }
    
      if (!is.data.frame(species_importance)) {
        warning("Importance data are not a data frame for: ", sp_name)
        print(class(species_importance))
        next
      }
    
      message(
        "Rows: ", nrow(species_importance),
        "; columns: ",
        paste(names(species_importance), collapse = ", ")
      )
    
      if (nrow(species_importance) == 0) {
        warning("Zero rows for: ", sp_name)
        next
      }
    
      safe_species <- gsub(
        "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]",
        "_",
        sp_name
      )
    
      p <- tryCatch(
        plot_variable_importance(
          importance_df = species_importance,
          species_name = sp_name,
          filename = paste0(
            safe_species,
            "_Variable_Relative_Influence"
          ),
          output_folder = importance_folder,
          rodent_var_labels = rodent_var_labels
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          warning(
            "Plotting failed for ", sp_name,
            ": ", conditionMessage(e)
          )
          return(NULL)
        }
      )
    
      if (!is.null(p)) {
        rodent_importance_plots[[sp_name]] <- p
      }
    }

# save averaged relative influence table
    importance_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(names(importance_results), function(sp_name) {
    
        df <- importance_results[[sp_name]]
    
        if (
          is.null(df) ||
          !is.data.frame(df) ||
          !all(c("var", "rel.inf") %in% names(df))
        ) {
          return(NULL)
        }
    
        df %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(var), !is.na(rel.inf)) %>%
          dplyr::group_by(var) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            Mean_Relative_Influence = mean(rel.inf, na.rm = TRUE),
            SD_Relative_Influence = sd(rel.inf, na.rm = TRUE),
            N_Replicates = dplyr::n(),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            Species = sp_name,
            .before = 1
          )
      })
    )

    write.csv(
      importance_summary,
      file.path(
        importance_folder,
        "Rodent_Mean_Variable_Relative_Influence.csv"
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

```
